## Vireo v0.14.2

Mac text sizing for the code editor and diff view, plus extra hardening for the git commands Vireo runs.

### Fixes

- **Editor and diff text sized for the Mac.** macOS draws text larger than Windows at the same size, so code in the editor (14.5px) and the diff view (13px) looked oversized next to the rest of the UI. On macOS they are now 12.5px and 12px, in line with the terminal and VS Code's Mac defaults. Windows is unchanged. Diff rows are measured rather than assumed, so scrolling through long diffs stays exact (`41c483c`).
- **Safer git commands.** Vireo already refused git options that can run another program. It now also refuses `--output` and `--open-files-in-pager` (including `git grep -O`), which could overwrite an arbitrary file or start a program if a request value ever reached git as an option. Harmless options with similar names, such as `--output-indicator-new`, `grep -o` and `log -O`, still work (`6774f1e`).

### Security

- Reviewed the open code-scanning and Dependabot alerts. The CodeQL "uncontrolled command line" finding on the git command builder is a false positive: the program is always `git`, no shell is involved, and option injection is blocked, now more tightly as described above. The `glib` advisory affects only Tauri's Linux GTK backend, which isn't compiled into the Windows or macOS builds.

### Installing on macOS

The macOS build is not notarized, so the first launch of a downloaded copy needs one extra step: open Vireo once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. You can also run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Vireo.app` in Terminal.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Cosmos-0118/vireo/compare/v0.14.1...v0.14.2
